requirements.title: Communication Stack Initialization
requirements.description: The communication stack shall be initialized before any communication can occur. All required modules must be configured and ready.

requirements.title: Message Transmission
requirements.description: The communication module shall transmit messages according to the configured protocol and timing parameters.

requirements.title: Diagnostic Event Manager Initialization
requirements.description: The Diagnostic Event Manager shall initialize all configured DTCs and diagnostic events on startup.

requirements.title: DTC Storage
requirements.description: When a diagnostic event occurs, the corresponding DTC shall be stored in non-volatile memory.

requirements.title: Non-Volatile Memory Initialization
requirements.description: The NvM module shall initialize and verify the integrity of all configured memory blocks on startup.

requirements.title: Data Write Operation
requirements.description: The NvM module shall write data to non-volatile memory and ensure data integrity through checksums.

requirements.title: Operating System Initialization
requirements.description: The AUTOSAR OS shall initialize all configured tasks, alarms, and resources before starting the application.

requirements.title: Task Scheduling
requirements.description: The OS shall schedule tasks according to their priority and activation conditions.

requirements.title: CAN Driver Initialization
requirements.description: The CAN driver shall initialize the hardware and configure baudrate, filters, and mailboxes.

requirements.title: CAN Message Reception
requirements.description: The CAN driver shall receive messages and notify the upper layers through configured callbacks.
